what_is_it.explanation: Concile is an open-source backend-as-a-service designed to eliminate standard plumbing like manual API design and websocket setup. Developers write plain TypeScript functions for queries and mutations, and the reactive engine automatically pushes updates to every connected screen when data changes. It uses an embedded SQLite database by default and supports switching to Postgres with a single flag.
what_is_it.one_line: An open-source reactive backend that updates data and client screens automatically without polling or REST boilerplate.
